title: Impacts of Racial Bias in Historical Training Data for News AI

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative analysis using Explainable AI (LIME) to identify feature importance and predictive words for the 'blacks' label, combined with qualitative content analysis (close reading) of high-scoring articles across historical and contemporary news datasets to evaluate stereotyping and misclassification (e.g., anti-Asian discrimination and Black Lives Matter).

Comparing the predictions of a model trained on historical data (1987-2007 NYT Annotated Corpus) against contemporary news articles to identify representational harms and systematic oversights caused by evolving social norms and terminology.
